findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: lookup_domain, domain_detail · Private data: lookup_domain, domain_detail, domains_on_ip, domains_in_range, get_certificate, certificates_by_key, domain_timeline, new_domains, search_domains, lookup_domains, provisioning, certificates_on_ip, list_dataset_files · Public sink: domains_on_ip, domains_in_range, get_certificate.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: lookup_domain, domain_detail · Private data: lookup_domain, domain_detail, domains_on_ip, domains_in_range, get_certificate, certificates_by_key, domain_timeline, new_domains, search_domains, lookup_domains, provisioning, certificates_on_ip, list_dataset_files · Public sink: domains_on_ip, domains_in_range, get_certificate

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
